subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should maintainers require redacted live `google-vertex` ADC proof before merging the sanitizer slice in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83991, and should the gaxios/nolyfill auth-stack repair be split into a separate follow-up?
rationale: Source evidence is strong for both the sanitizer gap and the auth-stack risk, but the affected path depends on credentialed external Google Vertex behavior that this read-only review could not live-test.

options.title: Require live Vertex proof and split the auth fix
options.body: Keep the issue open, require exact-head redacted Vertex proof for the sanitizer PR, and track the gaxios/nolyfill ADC transport fix separately if the live route still fails.

options.title: Accept sanitizer proof override
options.body: A Google provider owner can merge the sanitizer PR with an explicit proof override while leaving this issue open for auth-stack verification.

options.title: Consolidate into one broader provider PR
options.body: Pause the sanitizer PR only if maintainers want one combined Google Vertex sanitizer plus ADC transport change with live proof before landing.

recommendation.title: Require live Vertex proof and split the auth fix
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open, require exact-head redacted Vertex proof for the sanitizer PR, and track the gaxios/nolyfill ADC transport fix separately if the live route still fails.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest inspected history on both the shared Google thinking helper boundary and Vertex ADC repair decisions.
